page.overview:
What is Malbeth the Seer?

Malbeth the Seer was a Dúnadan of Arnor, and a royal counsellor of Arthedain who lived in the time of kings Araphant and Arvedui. Per his name, he was known for his powers of a seer.

When King Araphant's son was born in TA 1864, he persuaded him to name him Arvedui which meant Last king. He prophesied that either Arvedui would change his name and become king of a great realm or that many lives of men would pass until the same chance arose. This foretold the succession crisis in Gondor, when following the death of King Ondoher in TA 1944, Arvedui unsuccessfully claimed the throne.

He made at least two prophecies, one concerning Arvedui and the other about Aragorn II. He foretold that Arvedui would be the last king until Aragorn and that he would ride the Paths of the Dead.

Malbeth the Seer's name seemingly comes from a student of J.R.R. Tolkien named "Mariel Elizabeth".
